# Original registry archive

`rquickjs-sys-0.14.0.crate` is the complete, unmodified
[published crate](https://static.crates.io/crates/rquickjs-sys/rquickjs-sys-0.14.0.crate).
Its SHA-256 is `cee271d0eeba64f0915b846cb7ae02e16faf3dfdffdca91731101d9d30fe3423`,
matching the application lockfile and the reviewed native-input policy.

The archive retains its original Rust and QuickJS notices. The application's
[Rust package inventory](../../../../resources/licenses/rust/index.json) also
records this exact package and its original notices. It is test data and is
never executed or compiled by xtask.

Collector tests use the real reviewed source selection rather than replacing
the production checksums or maintaining a second synthetic copy of its headers.
